Description: Enemies start at the top of the Timeline.
Your creatures' spells deal 90% less damage.
Enemies deal 100% more damage and always deal critical damage.
Leader is immune to damage, debuffs, and stat reduction while allies are alive.
After your creatures cast a spell, they take damage equal to 20% of Maximum Health
Enemies have 100% more Health and take 50% less damage.
Your creatures' spells consume 3 additional Charges.
Your creatures cannot gain buffs or stats.
Your creatures' attacks deal 90% less damage.
Your creatures are afflicted with a random debuff at the start of their turns.
Enemies cannot take damage that exceeds more than 25% of their Maximum Health.
50% of damage taken by enemies is reflected, up to 100% of the enemies' Current Health.
Enemies resurrect after a short period of time.
After an enemy dies, all other enemies gain 30% stats.
